candidate_interpretation: Externally legible standards-governed empirical/procedural discipline versus internally generated expressive-symbolic possibility
evidence_for: Strict positive markers are transparent, factual, analytical, methodical, data-driven, rationalist, educational, quantitative, utilitarian, cautious, and problem-solving; 48 strict negative markers center narrative, poetic, metaphorical, dramatic, mystical, intuitive, creative, and improvisational expression; blind accountability R2=.704; focused accountability contrasts passed 10/10.
evidence_against: The positive pole contains several related mechanisms rather than one trait; professional-role and prompt-register structure may contribute.
best_human_analogue: No single construct; positive Dutifulness plus Orderliness/Perfectionism/Cautiousness and empirical Intellect, negative Openness/Imagination/Artistic Interests/Absorption/Expressiveness.
unmeasured_residual: Qwen-specific coupling of factual transparency and external accountability to communication register and symbolic possibility
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that independently separates external standards, empirical rigor, professional legibility, and expressive register while holding the other components fixed.

evidence_for: Positive context includes method, caution, planning, discipline, and standards-bearing professional roles; negative context includes spontaneity, impulsivity, and disorganization.
evidence_against: Highly concentrated positive markers emphasize factual/analytic epistemics; strict negative markers are mainly symbolic and imaginative, which low Conscientiousness does not entail; accountability prompts exceed determination/checking.
best_human_analogue: Conscientiousness decomposed into Dutifulness Orderliness Perfectionism Prudence and Cautiousness
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence showing broad Conscientiousness predicts both poles beyond its facets and beyond Openness/register measures.

candidate_interpretation: Intellect or expertise versus low Intellect
evidence_for: Analytical, quantitative, rationalist, educational, and data-driven markers; blind intelligence/expertise correlates strongly with PC1.
evidence_against: Human Intellect emphasizes abstract ideas, which aligns more naturally with negative PC2; low Intellect does not imply poetic or symbolic expression.
unmeasured_residual: External accountability transparency and negative expressive imagination
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence separating empirical analytic practice from abstract conceptual sophistication.

evidence_for: The negative strict pole has exceptionally coherent narrative, poetic, artistic, mystical, creative, and improvisational markers.
evidence_against: The positive pole is not simply low Openness and includes strong analytical and educational content.
best_human_analogue: Openness aspect plus Imagination Artistic Interests Absorption and Expressiveness
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that inverse Openness scores track the positive pole after accountability and expertise are controlled.

evidence_for: High PC1 roles include auditor, examiner, evaluator, validator, lawyer, researcher, reviewer, grader, and accountant; professional objective-certainty r=.394.
evidence_against: Professional role prompt conventions and cluster composition can create this pattern; positive strict markers are broader than occupations.
best_human_analogue: Dutifulness Honesty/Propriety and role-specific professional standards
unmeasured_residual: General empirical epistemics and artistic-symbolic negative content
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence showing the axis persists under matched nonprofessional roles with equivalent standards and knowledge demands.

candidate_interpretation: Direct situated experiential engagement versus inward abstract formally mediated integration
evidence_for: Strict positive markers are experiential, practical, inquisitive; strict negative markers are introverted, ritualistic, pensive, theoretical, abstract, reverent, conceptual, principled, solemn, erudite; prior blind abstraction r=-.655 and PC1-conditioned r=-.618; new abstract coding r=-.322 and ritual/formal coding r=-.255.
evidence_against: Positive-PC2 roles also contain developmental reactivity and social volatility; the positive inquisitive marker complicates a simple low-Intellect reading.
best_human_analogue: No single construct; inverse Intellect is the leading abstract counterpart, with Extraversion, Activity Level, Adventurousness/Inquisitiveness, Traditionalism, Impulsivity, and Seriousness as partial facets.
unmeasured_residual: Direct practical/embodied engagement and Qwen-specific coupling of ritual formality with abstract integration
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence separately measuring direct experience, practical action, social outwardness, embodiment, abstraction, and formal mediation on the same blinded role material.

candidate_interpretation: Embodied or physical engagement versus disembodied abstraction
evidence_for: Coordinate-blind physical coding correlates r=.145 with PC2, remains r=.145 controlling PC1, and adds delta R2=.019 beyond PC1 plus practical and social ratings; surfer is positive PC2 and physically coded.
evidence_against: Abstraction and ritual/formal coding are stronger; competitor is high PC2 without physical content, warrior is physically coded but negative PC2, coach is social rather than physical, and no SAPA physicality scale exists.
best_human_analogue: No direct human measure; Activity Level and Adventurousness are semantic neighbors only
unmeasured_residual: Bodily skill movement sensory engagement and manual practice
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence using a direct validated physical-activity or bodily-engagement measure rather than energy risk or social proxies.

evidence_for: The marker poles directly oppose practical/experiential and theoretical/abstract/conceptual; prior conditional and blind results strongly favor abstraction on the negative side.
evidence_against: New coordinate-blind practical coding is weak at r=.053; positive roles include developmental and social phenomena beyond practicality.
best_human_analogue: Inverse Intellect plus limited experiential and activity facets
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that practical application predicts PC2 after separating it from professional procedure and PC1.

evidence_for: Introverted is the strongest strict negative marker; extroverted and gregarious are broader target-dominant positive markers, supporting logical opposite-pole completion.
evidence_against: Coordinate-blind social-outward coding is only r=.066; neither pole's conceptual/practical content is explained by Extraversion.
best_human_analogue: Extraversion with Gregariousness as a narrow facet
unmeasured_residual: Abstraction ritual formality and practical experience
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that Extraversion predicts PC2 within matched abstraction and practical-engagement strata.

evidence_for: The highest PC2 roles include teenager, adolescent, toddler, procrastinator, infant, gossip, comedian, and fool; prior PC1-conditioned maturity signal is negative.
evidence_against: This does not explain experiential/practical/inquisitive markers fully and risks treating role archetypes as developmental measures.
best_human_analogue: Impulsivity and Activity Level are imperfect neighbors
unmeasured_residual: Integrated world-model structure and physical/practical engagement
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that maturity/integration ratings predict PC2 after abstraction and role-cluster effects are separated.

candidate_interpretation: Traditional or ritual formality versus flexibility/spontaneity
evidence_for: Ritualistic, reverent, principled, solemn, and formal are negative markers; new ritual/formal coding correlates r=-.255.
evidence_against: Traditionalism measures conventional morality and religion, not all theoretical abstraction or institutional form; interpersonal Flexibility is not its logical cognitive opposite.
unmeasured_residual: Secular formal procedure conceptual integration and direct experience
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that ritual and institutional formality have separable relationships to PC2.

candidate_interpretation: Coherent action under unresolved uncertainty versus incapacity
evidence_for: Prior ratings showed a positive PC2 component, and signed integration/coherence predicted PC2 at R2=.423.
evidence_against: PC1-conditioned abstraction was stronger; uncertainty exposure was near zero; professional coherent-uncertainty correlation was -.007.
evidence_that_would_discriminate: Evidence that coherent action predicts PC2 after abstraction integration maturity and role cluster are held constant.
